question: Bacterial and fungal enzymes degrade detritus into simpler inorganic substances. This process is called as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**catabolism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bacterial and fungal enzymes degrade detritus into simpler inorganic substances. This process is called as catabolism.
 
• The word **catabolism is from New Latin**, which got the roots from Greek: **κάτω Kato, "downward"** and** βάλλειν ballein**, "to throw".
 
• It breaks down large molecules like **polysaccharides, lipids, etc. into smaller units like monosaccharides, fatty acids, nucleotides, etc**.
 
• It is the breaking-down aspect of **metabolism**.
 
• Cells use the monomers released from breaking down polymers to either construct new polymer molecules or degrade them into simple waste products like **lactic acid, carbon dioxide, acetic acid, urea, and ammonia, releasing energy**.
 
• The creation of these wastes is usually an oxidation process involving a release of chemical-free energy. Of this, some are lost as heat, and the rest results in the formation of adenosine triphosphate (ATP).​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Catabolism** is a metabolic process in which complex molecules are broken down into simpler ones with the release of energy. In the context of the given statement, bacterial and fungal enzymes break down the complex detritus into simpler inorganic substances such as carbon dioxide, water, and mineral ions. This breakdown process releases energy that can be used by the decomposers or other organisms in the ecosystem.
 
• Fragmentation: Detritivores (e.g., earthworms) break down detritus into smaller particles. This process is called fragmentation.
 
• Leaching: By the process of leaching, water-soluble inorganic nutrients go down into the soil horizon and get precipitated as unavailable salts.
 
• Decomposition: It** **is the process of breaking down a substance into its constituent parts. Decomposition of dead organic matter occurs in nature and it is also called decay or putrefaction.​
